---
name: Request a new platform recipe
about: You'd like to integrate Like Me Like with a platform that isn't in this repo yet
title: "[platform] "
labels: enhancement
---

**Platform name**
e.g. "Continue.dev", "Cline", "Open WebUI"

**Link to the platform's integration docs**

**Does the platform support MCP natively?**
- [ ] Yes (Streamable-HTTP with header auth)
- [ ] Yes (stdio only)
- [ ] No — function calling / OpenAPI only
- [ ] No — custom plugin format

**Why is this useful?**
What channel does this platform reach that the existing
integrations don't?

**Are you willing to draft a PR?**
- [ ] Yes
- [ ] No, I'd like someone else to take it
